rules.label: Years of Relevant Experience
rules.suggestion: State your total years of professional commercial experience in the target role explicitly.

rules.label: Production & Commercial Engineering Experience
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate professional industry experience shipping production-grade software in commercial or enterprise environments.

rules.label: Large-Scale Architecture, High Concurrency & Systems Impact
rules.suggestion: Provide quantifiable engineering evidence operating distributed systems at high scale and low latency.

rules.label: Deep Learning & Machine Learning Frameworks (PyTorch / TensorFlow / JAX)
rules.suggestion: Highlight hands-on model training, optimization, and evaluation using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX.

rules.label: Advanced Architectures (Transformers / LLMs / Computer Vision)
rules.suggestion: Showcase modern architectural implementations (Transformers, LLMs, RAG, or Computer Vision) with concrete performance results.

rules.label: Production MLOps, Model Serving & Deployment
rules.suggestion: Detail production model serving, inference acceleration, and automated MLOps pipelines using Triton, ONNX, or vLLM.

rules.label: Distributed Training & Multi-GPU Acceleration
rules.suggestion: Showcase scalable distributed model training across multi-GPU or cluster environments.

rules.label: Mathematical & Statistical Foundations
rules.suggestion: Emphasize foundational mathematical formulation of loss functions, statistical inference, and optimization.

rules.label: Data Science & Feature Engineering Pipeline
rules.suggestion: Detail data cleaning, feature extraction, and manipulation with NumPy, Pandas, or distributed data frameworks.

rules.label: High-Performance Systems & Languages (C++ / CUDA / Python)
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate proficiency in C++ or CUDA for systems engineering and high-throughput computational models.

rules.label: Model Evaluation, Validation & Benchmarking
rules.suggestion: Detail quantitative evaluation metrics, error analysis, benchmarking, and validation methodologies.

rules.label: CI/CD Pipeline Automation
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate automated CI/CD pipeline creation, build triggers, and deployment workflows.

rules.label: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
rules.suggestion: Show hands-on experience provisioning and managing infrastructure declaratively using Terraform or Ansible.

rules.label: Kubernetes & Container Orchestration
rules.suggestion: Highlight container cluster management, Helm charts, ingress, and production deployment on Kubernetes.

rules.label: Cloud Infrastructure & Networking
rules.suggestion: Provide concrete examples architecting secure cloud networking, IAM policies, and cloud infrastructure.

rules.label: Observability, Telemetry & SRE
rules.suggestion: Showcase metrics collection, alert management, and system observability using tools like Prometheus/Grafana.

rules.label: Linux Systems & Scripting
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate Linux systems administration, networking fundamentals, and shell automation.

rules.label: DevSecOps & Infrastructure Hardening
rules.suggestion: Detail automated vulnerability scanning, secrets rotation, and cloud security hardening.

rules.label: Backend Architecture & REST APIs
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate scalable server architecture and production REST API design.

rules.label: Relational Database Modeling & SQL Optimization
rules.suggestion: Detail relational database modeling, indexing strategies, transactions, and performance query tuning.

rules.label: In-Memory Caching & NoSQL Datastores
rules.suggestion: Detail distributed caching with Redis/Memcached and NoSQL document/column stores.

rules.label: Distributed Systems, Message Queues & Event-Driven Architecture
rules.suggestion: Showcase asynchronous messaging pipelines, event-driven microservices, and queue consumers.

rules.label: Authentication, API Security & Access Control
rules.suggestion: Highlight secure authentication mechanisms, JWT handling, access control, and API defense.

rules.label: API Contracts, Schema & RPC Protocols
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate formal API specifications, gRPC/Protobuf protocols, or GraphQL schemas.

rules.label: Backend Testing & Test-Driven Development
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate automated unit, integration, and API test coverage with Jest or PyTest.

rules.label: Modern Frontend & React Ecosystem
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate frontend component architecture, responsive design, and state management.

rules.label: TypeScript & Static Type Systems
rules.suggestion: Highlight production development using strongly-typed TypeScript interfaces and generics.

rules.label: Global State Management & Server State
rules.suggestion: Detail state management and asynchronous data fetching patterns with Redux Toolkit or React Query.

rules.label: Responsive UI, Tailwind CSS & Component Styling
rules.suggestion: Showcase clean responsive layout implementation using Tailwind CSS or modern CSS paradigms.

rules.label: Web Performance, SSR & Core Web Vitals
rules.suggestion: Highlight web performance profiling, SSR with Next.js, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

rules.label: Frontend Component & End-to-End Testing
rules.suggestion: Include automated component and end-to-end UI testing practices.

rules.label: Version Control & Collaborative Engineering
rules.suggestion: Demonstrate clean Git workflow, branching, and pull request collaboration.
